title: Guénette, S. (December 2013). An exploratory ecosystem model of the Bay of Bengal Large Marine Ecosystem. BOBLME Project.
material_read: Exact local 62-page PDF text; full A1.1 pp37–41, A1.3 pp43–45, A1.2 p42, A2.1 p46, source pp7–11 and Table16 p24; A3.1 pp50–53 checked for scope. Geography reviewer visually checked Pristis perotteti in A1.3 p43.
supports: Reporting-category assignments; selected non-exhaustive composition; qualitative ecological guilds; geographic habitat areas; same-area source-model catches.
limits: A3.1 is diet-study evidence, not exhaustive membership. A1.3 lacks numeric stage/size cutoffs and is not an exhaustive constituent list. Model caught-mass proportions are proxies for target-taxon mixture and 2019 landings, not direct observations.

title: Frozen LME034 2019-landings validation baseline
material_read: All315 exact catch labels, provider fields, classic TL/coefficient/contribution, prior593 matching rows and selected group numerical fields.
supports: Independent simple-chain denominator and old/new reconciliation.
limits: Old Matching stores aggregate confidence but no M/W component confidence; old components remain null rather than invented.

title: WoRMS public Aphia REST authority records, retrieved30 September2026
material_read: Complete retained public JSON taxonomic entries; final sawfish/eel entries include complete AphiaClassification ancestry trees.
supports: Same-taxon bridges, historical family concepts and ancestry for explicit competing source members.
limits: Taxonomy does not observe regional catch composition. One Scomberomorini name lookup failed; genus containment instead uses the read FAO2007 classification table.

title: Zacharia, P.U.; Joshi, K.K.; Kandan, P. (2011). First record of the pelagic stingray Pteroplatytrygon violacea (Bonaparte,1832) from the east coast of India. Indian Journal of Fisheries58(1):95–98.
supports: Tuticorin east-India landed record on9July2009 confirms a regional pelagic-stingray exception.

title: CSIRO Codes for Australian Aquatic Biota: Lepidocybium flavobrunneum, CAAB37439008

supports: Supported ecological extension to non-exhaustive medium/large deep-water guild.
limits: Australian habitat evidence is not a Bay of Bengal composition survey or exact source-member assignment.

title: FAO (2007). Global fishery resources of tuna and tuna-like species; AppendixI classification table, printedp45/PDFp56.
supports: Scomberomorus genus belongs to source-named tribe Scomberomorini.

supports: Pelagic continental-shelf habitat supports a coastal ecological extension.

title: FAO sandbar shark Carcharhinus plumbeus habitat entry, PDFp34.
supports: Coastal-pelagic continental/insular shelves and adjacent deeper water support coastal ecological extension.

supports: Reject unsupported earlier claim that source-listed S.argus is the only relevant regional scatophagid; retain a disclosed congeneric extension for the genus.
